messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU-serving cluster `us-west-2-inference` queue length > 1200, avg wait 18s, autoscaler failed 3x to provision new nodes due to quota/limit error. Incident severity: P1.

alice_oncall: seeing the alert, joining. Paging infra and SRE.

bob_infra: i'm on it, pulling autoscaler logs now. initial guess: new model rollout increased per-session KV-cache size causing higher memory per worker, autoscaler hit max-gpu-per-az policy.

carla_sre: any customer-facing impact? metrics show elevated 429 throttles on `/v1/generate` for several tenants. Support queue spiking.

eve_support: confirmed — multiple customers reporting slow responses and some 429s. Top affected: acme-inc (prod), beta-app (staging but heavy). Escalating to CSMs.

alice_oncall: thanks. rollcall: @bob_infra lead autoscaler, @carla_sre incident coordinator, @dave_prod root cause / rollout lead. If we need to rollback, who has permission?

dave_prod: rollout 2024-06-27 03:10 UTC of `gptx-1.2.kv-v2` was the change. We pushed it to hosted default; traffic-weighted canary at 100% now. I can start rollback if required.

bob_infra: autoscaler logs show repeated failure to create instances: `QuotaExceeded: Requested 8 GPUs, but quota is 4` then fallback attempts. Also kube pods staying pending due to `InsufficientMemory` events.

carla_sre: immediate customer impact: increased latency (p95 token latency +120ms) and queue growth. Risk: sustained queue will cause further 429s. Mitigations: 1) throttle non-paid / lower tier routes, 2) scale up reserved capacity (if we can), 3) rollback model rollout. Which is fastest?

bob_infra: fastest: toggle routing to fallback model variant (pre-rollout `gptx-1.1.base`) at the edge — that's a config flip, no infra changes. If we need capacity expansion, that will take 10-20 min for new machines and quota approvals.

dave_prod: agree. prepare a quick rollback/reroute plan. I'll open an immediate rollout revert and set weight to 0 for `kv-v2`.

deploy-bot: deploy request 1719504387 submitted by dave_prod: revert rollout `gptx-1.2.kv-v2` -> `gptx-1.1.base`. Canary traffic set to 0%. ETA ~45s to start.

carla_sre: while revert is in flight, enable emergency rate limit: set `tier:free` qps=5, `tier:standard` qps=20 only for generation endpoints. @bob_infra can you apply?

bob_infra: applying rate limits now. patch: `rl set --env prod --route /v1/generate --tier free=5,standard=20`

bob_infra: rate limits applied. monitoring for 429s...

deploy-bot: rollback rollout 1719504387: canary traffic update accepted, starting reroute.

alice_oncall: note for responders: enable KV-cache flush TTL reductions after rollback to free memory on current workers. @dave_prod do we have a config?

dave_prod: yes, setting `kv_cache.max_session_kv=64MB` temporarily for active workers. Pushing config change.

dave_prod: config pushed. recommending to also reduce max context length for non-enterprise plans to 2048 tokens for the next 30m.

bob_infra: new nodes are still stuck due to quota; opening cloud support ticket for temporary quota bump. ticket# CS-12895. ETA for response ~15-25m.

carla_sre: monitoring: 1 min after rollback start, queue length dropping from 1200 -> 600. latency trending down. 429 rate decreased by ~40%.

eve_support: messaging CSMs and posting to status page with initial notice: "Partial degradation to inference. We are rolling back a recent model update and applying mitigations. Some customers may see throttling. ETA ~30-60m."

alice_oncall: good. please capture exact rollback hash and runtime IDs for postmortem. Also note who approved the rollback. dave_prod confirmed.

bob_infra: autoscaler adjustments: current policy had `max_gpus_per_az=100` and `gpu_request_padding=0.95`. The model increases per-pod GPU memory footprint by ~27%, pushing effective capacity lower. Propose lowering `gpu_request_padding` to 0.8 and temporarily increase `max_gpus_per_az` to 200 while cloud quota is being resolved. Need SRE approval for risk.

carla_sre: approving temporary policy change. bob_infra proceed, but tag with incident id and revert timeline.

bob_infra: policy patched. new autoscaler behavior in effect. monitoring provisioning attempts.

carla_sre: update: queue down to 220, p95 token latency back to baseline +10ms. 429s near baseline. Looks like rollback + rate limiting + kv config did the trick.

eve_support: customer comms being updated: flagged acme-inc as impacted, outreach started. No major revenue-impacting customers on customers-reports list beyond minor API timeouts.

alice_oncall: transition: @carla_sre you remain incident lead, @bob_infra keep infra actions until quota settled, @dave_prod own follow-up and postmortem. I'll start a pager handoff in 30m unless we see regression.

carla_sre: noted. capturing notes: root cause hypothesis: rollout of `gptx-1.2.kv-v2` increased KV cache size and per-worker memory, causing autoscaler to hit quota and pods to accumulate pending queue. Secondary factor: autoscaler padding settings and `max_gpus_per_az` hard limit.

dave_prod: action items for postmortem: 1) revert rollout (done), 2) add automated pre-rollout simulation for effective GPU memory usage estimation, 3) add rollout safety: gradual scale thresholds tied to memory metrics, 4) add unit tests for context-length regression surface.

bob_infra: action items: 1) revert autoscaler temp patches after quota sorted, 2) request permanent quota increase and better alerting on `InsufficientMemory` events, 3) add quick-playbook to re-route traffic to fallback model automatically when queue > 500 for >5m.

carla_sre: support action items: 1) timeline and customer impact summary, 2) update status page, 3) coordinate CSM outreach for impacted accounts.

alice_oncall: closing loop for live mitigation: rollback complete, rate limits applied then relaxed, kv TTL reduced, autoscaler patched temporarily, queue recovered. Keep watch.

deploy-bot: rollback 1719504387: complete. new routing hash: `route-7a12f3` -> `gptx-1.1.base`

bob_infra: cloud support responded: temporary quota bump granted +80 GPUs in us-west-2 for 2 hours. will monitor and then scale down.

carla_sre: current status: SERVICE_DEGRADED -> MONITORING. handoff to oncall for 30m.

alice_oncall: handing off to night oncall @eve_support for monitoring customer escalations and to @bob_infra for infra watch. If any re-escalation, page SRE.

eve_support: oncall ack. will escalate if customers see repeat 429s.

carla_sre: logging incident as `INC-2024-06-27-gpu-rollout-kvcache`. Please add evidence: autoscaler logs, pod events, rollout history, traffic-weighting snapshots.

dave_prod: adding all artifacts to the ticket and will draft postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

alice_oncall: incident thread closed for active mitigation; keep this thread for PM/postmortem comments.

incident-bot: incident INC-2024-06-27-gpu-rollout-kvcache transitioned to MONITORING by carla_sre at 1719508199
